channel.title: XKey Updates
channel.description: XKey - Vietnamese Input Method for macOS

item.title: Version 1.2.27 (Build 20261113)
item.description:
What's New

feat(startup): keep the last language across relaunch

XKey.app forced Vietnamese on at every cold start whenever the input

source was enabled for it, discarding the E the user left it in. Only

XKeyIM read the persisted flag, so the two hosts disagreed after a

restart.

The first input-source sync after launch now keeps the persisted

language for apps without a Smart Switch entry. A saved per-app entry

still wins, a source configured off still forces E, and later

input-source switches keep re-enabling Vietnamese.

  • Add isInitialSync to handleInputSourceChange and a testable

inputSourceSyncLanguage decision helper

  • Cover the launch precedence with LaunchLanguageTests
  • Bump MARKETINGVERSION to 1.2.27 and CURRENTPROJECT_VERSION to 20261113

Xem chi tiết trên GitHub
